name: NC Office of State Fire Marshal

plan.title: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

mission.text: To protect the lives and property of North Carolina residents and emergency responders by delivering outstanding service through comprehensive risk reduction programs.

citation.document: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Complete and expand the Emergency Training Center for state-of-the-art disaster readiness training.

citation.document: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Advance online training and testing to improve accessibility.

citation.document: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Develop a State Emergency Response Team (SERT) plan and lead collaboration with federal, state and local partners in response and recovery.

citation.document: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Conduct risk assessments for state agencies, DPI and community colleges to reduce property loss.

citation.document: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Develop and educate stakeholders on building and fire codes to ensure public safety.

citation.document: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Disburse grant funding to volunteer fire departments, rescue squads and EMS units to purchase equipment.

citation.document: NC Office of State Fire Marshal Strategic Plan 2025-2029

wording_note: Goals and objectives are close summaries of the plan posted on the OSBM Agency Strategic Plans page (retrieved 2026-11-07); check the cited section before quoting. Keywords, search terms and usual funders were chosen by the team as matching aids.
